APPROVED FUNCTIONAL CHARGING HMI AND CONTROLLER, issue50, 2026-10-18. Siemens2024 MTP7007inch1.65kg TypeII EPD DI_FA_EPD00059.01; S7-1200 CPU1215C0.35kg TypeII EPD DI_FA_EPD00043.02; https://cache.industry.siemens.com/dl/files/852/109975852/att_1301876/v1/SIMATIC_HMI_Unified_Comfort_6AV2128-3GB06-0AX1_DI_FA_EPD00059.01.pdf ; https://cache.industry.siemens.com/dl/files/753/109955753/att_1294229/v1/SIMATIC_S7-1200_CPU_6ES7215-1AG40-0XB0_DI_FA_EPD00043.02.pdf Replace one whole laptop and one17inch desktop monitor by one7inch MTP700-class industrial HMI plus one compact PLC, total2kg. These are functional engineering analogues, not certified ABB chargers or a complete safety-control architecture. EPD rounded percentages total100.01/99.99; resolve only published rounding to their stated1.65/0.35kg device masses, not normalize an incomplete recipe. Keep HMI other2.31% explicitly UNRESOLVED; do not assign it invented zero-metal composition. Electronics categories use mounted Pb-free-board proxy by mass, including its chips/connectors/precious metals once; actual display backlight, processor, PLC relays and communications ICs are not separately resolved. No extra complete monitor or laptop is purchased. HMI16:9 diagonal7inch gives active area0.013508157151335309m2. Native ecoinvent sputtering documentation specifies TFT150nm top+50nm bottom: use200nm total, volume2.7016314302670617e-09m3, rather than17inch area or500nm default. The sputtering supplier already includes target production and85%target scrap, about15%deposition yield; do NOT add another target-yield multiplier or separate indium purchase. At assumed7140kg/m3 this is1.928964841210682e-05kg retained ITO; subtract that film mass from the EPD glazing envelope before buying generic flat-glass proxy. Native target composition/process remain proxies; test100-500nm and10-30%yield. Paper, ABS-class thermoplastic,18/8stainless andalumina are material-class proxies, not measured grades. Keep existing8.25kg charging-stand electronics as a separate protection/comms allowance; its purpose/BOM remains unresolved, not removed as proven duplication. This means full controls mass remains uncertain. Existing11Cu+1Al+73steel stand structure remains for legacy users; dedicated450kW reference partitions its own control cabinet/structure without purchasing this whole stand again. EPD10year life is only a reference: one installed controller/HMI set retained at existing stand service allocation; replacement sensitivity1-2sets and PLC architecture remain gaps. Operation is already within vehicle grid-consumption boundary, no second standby or loss energy added. End-of-life of HMI/PLC is an explicit gap; no EPD avoided-burden recycling credits imported. Retain100%assembly reference with1kWh/kg assembly engineering allowance; supplier yields remain.
